description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Message Latchbell’s website designer, as the owner does in the dashboard. It works in the background, often for minutes, and this answers at once: read my_website about every 30 seconds until working is null and queued is 0. The last line of designer_chat says how it went: a designer line is its reply, a latchbell line means the turn didn’t finish. A message sent while it’s busy waits its turn. Use it sparingly, at critical steps (the first structure, a failed check, a redesign): it costs AI credits. For everyday changes prefer upload_site_pages.
name: site_designer_chat
title: Message the website designer
